name: Monclova

queries.query: Monclova Mexico cadastral parcel map registry official Coahuila
queries.result: First-party results identified the official Monclova municipal Catastro page, the municipal Predial account portal, the state Instituto Registral y Catastral (IRYC), the state public-registry office directory, and state cadastral-service listings. No public anonymous parcel map, feature service, or safe ID-plus-geometry endpoint was identified.

queries.result: Los resultados oficiales identificaron Catastro de la Presidencia Municipal de Monclova, el portal de consulta de predial, el Instituto Registral y Catastral estatal, la oficina registral de Monclova y trámites estatales para copias de cartografía catastral. No se identificó un mapa público anónimo de parcelas ni un servicio de geometría con identificador nativo seguro.

registryEvidence.officialNationalCustodian: Instituto Registral y Catastral del Estado de Coahuila de Zaragoza (IRYC)
registryEvidence.localCustodian: Dirección de Catastro Municipal, Presidencia Municipal de Monclova; the state directory also identifies an Oficina Registral Monclova.
registryEvidence.assessment: A local cadastral custodian is directly evidenced by the current municipal Catastro page, which lists cadastral procedures and an in-person Catastro service window in Monclova. The state IRYC page identifies the state cadastral/registral authority and the state office directory assigns Monclova and surrounding municipalities to the Monclova district. This is registry/custodian evidence, not open parcel geometry coverage.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Page retrieved. It lists municipal cadastral procedures including cadastral appraisal, subdivision, fusion, certification, deslinde, and cadastral-plan requirements, plus the Catastro service window at Zaragoza and V. Carranza, Monclova. It exposes no map viewer, API, layer URL, schema, CRS, or anonymous parcel geometry. The page includes requirements involving deeds, liens, tax receipts, INE, and other unsafe/property records; none were requested or retained.

attemptedRoutes.method: GET then bounded direct GET to https://predial.monclova.gob.mx/appWeb/
attemptedRoutes.outcome: The public page is an account-number consultation/payment form. A direct TLS-verified curl request to /appWeb/ returned HTTP 406 Not Acceptable from nginx/ModSecurity. No login, account number, address, owner, tax, or other unsafe lookup was attempted. No JavaScript/configuration exposing a parcel map or geometry API was available from the retrieved response.

Page retrieved. IRYC states it is the state public-registry and cadastral authority, establishes cadastral policy across Coahuila, and links online procedures and cadastral value tables. No public parcel viewer, feature service, schema, CRS, or safe geometry endpoint was exposed.

Page retrieved. It lists services for cadastral appraisals, certification of plans and rustic parcels, urban cadastral cartography copies, general urban cadastral plans, coordinate control points, and related document services. These are request/copy procedures, not an open parcel API. No geometry, schema, CRS, or safe native parcel ID was retrieved.

Page retrieved. The Monclova office jurisdiction explicitly includes Monclova and surrounding municipalities. The page is an office/service directory and does not expose cadastral parcel geometry or an anonymous map endpoint.

An INEGI Coahuila cadastral/cartographic sheet was found, but it is a regional/cartographic product rather than a city parcel feature service and provides no safe native parcel IDs or full parcel polygons for Monclova.
